description: Schedule K-1 (Form 1065), tax years 2000 through 2025. Extract visible fields and continuation rows without deriving workpaper values.

official__k1_status_final.instruction: Inspect the small square immediately to the left of the 'Final K-1' label at the top of page 1. Return exactly CHECKED when that square contains any printed X, check mark, fill, or crossing stroke. Return exactly UNCHECKED only when that square is visually empty. The source document may use a typed X rather than a check-mark glyph. Do not decide from the label text alone or from the nearby Amended K-1 square; evaluate this square independently.

official__k1_status_amended.instruction: Inspect the small square immediately to the left of the 'Amended K-1' label at the top of page 1. Return exactly CHECKED when that square contains any printed X, check mark, fill, or crossing stroke. Return exactly UNCHECKED only when that square is visually empty. The source document may use a typed X rather than a check-mark glyph. Do not decide from the label text alone or from the nearby Final K-1 square; evaluate this square independently.

official__box_11_entries.instruction: All visible coded rows for box 11 entries. Each item must be compact JSON with code, description, and amount. Preserve row order.

official__box_13_entries.instruction: Return all populated Schedule K-1 line 13 rows. When the face of the K-1 shows a code followed by STMT or an asterisk, follow the matching Federal Statements page in the same tax package and return each actual statement deduction with its code, description, and amount; do not leave a blank STMT placeholder when numeric statement rows are available. Do not extract the printed code legend. Each item must be compact JSON with code, description, and amount. Preserve row order.

official__box_17_entries.instruction: Return only actually populated Schedule K-1 line 17 entries. Do not extract the form's printed A-F code taxonomy or its blank template lines as separate rows. A row is populated only when a value or statement marker is visibly entered beside its code. If line 17 is visible but entirely blank, return exactly one compact JSON placeholder with code '', description 'Alternative Minimum Tax (AMT)', and amount ''. Each item must be compact JSON with code, description, and amount. Preserve row order.

official__box_18_entries.instruction: All visible coded rows for box 18 entries. Each item must be compact JSON with code, description, and amount. Preserve row order.

official__box_19_entries.instruction: Return only actually populated Schedule K-1 line 19 coded rows. Each item must use the letter code visibly printed beside that same amount; do not also emit an uncoded generic line 19 row and do not extract blank code-taxonomy labels. Each item must be compact JSON with code, description, and amount. Preserve row order.

official__box_20_entries.instruction: Return only actually populated Schedule K-1 line 20 rows. Read the code and value from the same physical line: an amount printed as 20A must have code A, and statement rows such as Z* or AG* must retain the asterisk. Never copy a line 19 distribution amount into line 20. A line 20 row described as Distributions or Cash and marketable securities is invalid because those descriptions belong to line 19; omit it. When both 19A and 20A are populated, read their amounts independently from their own physical lines. Never emit an uncoded numeric line 20 row when a code is visibly present. Do not extract blank code-taxonomy labels. Each item must be compact JSON with code, description, and amount. Preserve row order.

official__box_21_entries.instruction: All visible coded rows for box 21 entries. Each item must be compact JSON with code, description, and amount. Preserve row order.
